nodes.summary: The expected number of sites with `i` derived copies in a sample of `n`, `1 ≤ i < n`, is bounded uniformly in the selection coefficient: `|E ξ_i(σ)| ≤ |θ| C(n, i)`.
nodes.title: Uniform bound on the expected site-frequency spectrum

nodes.summary: The Poisson-random-field frequency density averaged over the distribution of fitness effects `μ`: `∫ φ_σ(x) dμ(σ)`.
nodes.title: Frequency density averaged over a distribution of fitness effects

nodes.summary: The spectrum is additive in the (finite) DFE.
nodes.title: DFE spectrum is additive in the measure

nodes.summary: A DFE concentrated on one selection coefficient gives the single-`σ` spectrum.
nodes.title: Spectrum under a point-mass DFE is the single-selection spectrum

nodes.summary: For a finite measure `μ` of selection coefficients and a segregating class `1 ≤ i < n`, the DFE-averaged spectrum is the binomial sampling integral of the DFE-averaged frequency density: `∫ E ξ_i(σ) dμ(σ) = ∫₀¹ C(n, i) x ^ i (1 - x) ^ (n - i) (∫ φ_σ(x) dμ(σ)) dx`.
nodes.title: Mixture identity

nodes.summary: The spectrum under the gamma DFE as an integral against the gamma law of the strength.
nodes.title: Site-frequency spectrum under the gamma DFE

nodes.summary: The spectrum is homogeneous in the DFE.
nodes.title: DFE spectrum is homogeneous in the measure

nodes.summary: The expected unfolded site-frequency spectrum under the distribution of fitness effects `μ` (a law on the scaled selection coefficient `σ = 2Ns`): `∫ E ξ_i(σ) dμ(σ)`, where each new mutation draws its own `σ` from `μ`.
nodes.title: Site-frequency spectrum under a distribution of fitness effects

nodes.summary: Under the gamma DFE no mutation is beneficial.
nodes.title: No mutation is beneficial under the gamma DFE

nodes.summary: Rescaling a gamma DFE by `c > 0` (for example from `s` to `σ = 2Ns`, `c = 2N`) keeps the shape and divides the rate by `c`.
nodes.title: Rescaling a gamma DFE divides its rate

nodes.summary: The fraction of new mutations whose strength `-σ` lies in `(c₁, c₂]`, `0 ≤ c₁ ≤ c₂`, is `(Γ(a, r c₁) - Γ(a, r c₂)) / Γ(a)`.
nodes.title: Fraction of mutations in a strength interval under the gamma DFE

nodes.summary: Under the gamma DFE the fraction of new mutations with `σ < -c`, `c ≥ 0`, is the gamma tail `Γ(a, r c) / Γ(a)`.
nodes.title: Fraction of strongly deleterious mutations

nodes.summary: The gamma distribution of fitness effects (Boyko et al. 2008): the scaled selection coefficient is `σ = -T` with `T ~ Gamma(a, r)`, shape `a > 0` and rate `r > 0` (scale `1 / r`), so new mutations are deleterious with mean strength `a / r`.
nodes.title: Gamma distribution of fitness effects

nodes.summary: The derivative of the log-likelihood in the parameter `ψ`, when the means `E_i(ψ)` are positive and differentiable at `ψ`: `∑ (k_i / E_i(ψ) - 1) · DE_i(ψ)`.
nodes.title: Derivative of the Poisson log-likelihood

nodes.summary: For `1 ≤ i < n`, the expected spectrum `E ξ_i(σ)` is integrable in `σ` against every finite measure.
nodes.title: Integrability of the expected spectrum in the selection coefficient

nodes.summary: The mean scaled selection coefficient under the gamma DFE is `-a / r`.
nodes.title: Mean selection coefficient under the gamma DFE

nodes.summary: The gamma DFE is a probability law.
nodes.title: Gamma DFE is a probability measure

nodes.summary: For independent Poisson counts with positive means `E_i`, the log-probability of the observed counts `k` is `poissonLogLik E k`.
nodes.title: The Poisson-random-field log-likelihood

nodes.summary: The joint law of independent Poisson counts with means `E_i` gives the count vector `k` the probability `∏ e^{-E_i} E_i ^ {k_i} / (k_i!)`.
nodes.title: Probability of a count vector under independent Poisson laws

nodes.summary: With means `E_i = θ f_i` linear in the mutation parameter, positive `f_i` and at least one count, every `θ > 0` has likelihood at most that of `θ̂ = ∑ k_i / ∑ f_i`.
nodes.title: Profile maximum in `θ`

nodes.summary: The Poisson log-likelihood `∑ (k_i log E_i - E_i - log k_i!)` of counts `k_i` with means `E_i`. Meaningful for `E_i > 0`; at `E_i = 0` Lean's `log 0 = 0` gives a junk value.
nodes.title: Poisson log-likelihood of counts

nodes.summary: If `ψ` maximizes the Poisson log-likelihood over a parameter set `S` that is a neighborhood of `ψ`, and the means are positive and differentiable at `ψ`, then `∑ (k_i / E_i(ψ) - 1) · DE_i(ψ) = 0`.
nodes.title: Score equations

nodes.summary: The variance of the scaled selection coefficient under the gamma DFE is `a / r ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Variance of the selection coefficient under the gamma DFE

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
